Bug_Details:
Invalid time zone identifier. TimeZone.getTimeZone(String) will silently return GMT instead of the time zone you intended. TimeZone.getTimeZone(String) silently returns GMT when an invalid time zone
identifier is passed in.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the `TimeZone.getTimeZone` method. The method takes a string argument representing the time zone ID. In this example, the argument is set to `InvalidTimeZoneID`, which is an invalid time zone identifier. The method will silently return the time zone with the ID `GMT` instead of throwing an exception or returning `null`.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling TimeZone.getTimeZone() with an invalid time zone identifier, which should return GMT instead of the time zone intended.
